profile.address: Avenida San Jorge / San Jorge Etorbidea, 81, Pamplona/Iruña, Navarra, Spain
profile.reading:
This is one of the two data processing centres of the Government of Navarra, in Pamplona in northern Spain, operated by NASERTIC. This particular record covers the centre at the company's head office, which OpenStreetMap places on Calle de Orcoyen in the San Juan district of Pamplona, postcode 31011, and tags as lying one level below ground. That matches the registered address NASERTIC publishes for its head office, Calle Orkoien s/n, 31011 Pamplona. The two Navarra rows in this registry are not duplicates. The mapper who added them in March 2026 stated plainly in the changeset comment that both data processing centres of the Government of Navarra were being added, and the second sits about three kilometres east on the Carretera de Sarriguren in the Beloso area, on a building already carrying a NASERTIC operator tag. An address on Avenida San Jorge recorded against these rows in an earlier pass belongs to NASERTIC's telecommunications and digitalisation office, not to either data centre.

NASERTIC, in full Navarra de Servicios y Tecnologias S.A.U., is the public technology company of the regional government. It forms part of the Corporacion Publica Empresarial de Navarra and is attached to the Department of the Presidency and Equality, describes more than forty years of operating history and a staff of more than 180 professionals, and states that it does not seek profit and does not compete with private firms.

The original data centre was delivered in 2017 as a container based prefabricated modular facility built to Tier III availability standards, completed in five months against a typical eighteen to thirty six month timeline for comparable projects, at an investment of 1.28 million euros. It was developed jointly by NASERTIC, Aquads Technologies and Schneider Electric, designed to run alongside NASERTIC's existing data centre for redundancy, and won an innovation prize from Data Center Market magazine for the best containerised centre at Tier III availability.

In December 2023 the Navarra government declared a major expansion and modernisation of the centre an investment of regional interest, a designation granting preferential and expedited treatment across Navarra's public administration procedures. Engineering documentation for the 2024 to 2025 expansion phase describes a 1,258 square metre technical space with 270 racks rated at 100 kilowatts each, an initial electrical service of 20 megawatts expandable to 40 megawatts across five 4 megawatt transformers, which is utility supply capacity rather than IT load, and an uninterruptible power supply rated at 1 megawatt in a 2N configuration. Cooling runs on four separate thermal circuits, a condensation loop, direct liquid cooling, rear door heat exchangers and ambient cooling, supported by evaporative cooling towers rated at 17 megawatts of heat rejection. The design also includes VESDA smoke detection, a custom building management system and smart water management. NASERTIC describes the centre as carrying digital services for Navarra's citizens, its regional administration and its public enterprises.
profile.research_note: Corrected 2026-09-05. The prior note on both Navarra rows claimed near-identical coordinates and treated them as possible duplicates. That is wrong. Changeset 179192155 (2026-03-01, user Agazzr, imagery SITNA + PNOA) is commented "Anadidos los dos Centros de Procesamiento de Datos del Gobierno de Navarra", explicitly adding two distinct centres, and the objects are about 3 km apart. This row, way/1484174881, carries level=-1 and reverse-geocodes to Calle de Orcoyen, San Juan, Pamplona 31011, matching NASERTIC's published head office address C/ Orkoien s/n, 31011 Pamplona. The sibling node/13608563509 reverse-geocodes to Carretera de Sarriguren, Beloso, Pamplona 31016 and sits on way/127615729, an existing building already tagged operator=Nasertic. The Avenida San Jorge 81 address previously recorded in the profile is NASERTIC's Telco y Digitalizacion office (31012) per the company's own contact page, not a data centre, and is flagged in the public text. Corporate facts (CPEN group, Department of the Presidency and Equality, 40+ years, 180+ staff) taken fresh from nasertic.es. Power figures relabelled: the 20 MW rising to 40 MW is utility service capacity, not IT load.
